luiskr.com / experiments/star-field/engine/fill-worker / fillField

function fillField(action, base, count, fixedLen): Promise<SFFill | null>

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/fill-worker.ts:63

Dispatches one buffer fill to the worker pool, chunked by index range for true multi-threading. base carries the job's constant payload — seed, geometry params and the p-token map the worker mirrors — plus count records split into ≤MAX_CHUNKS equal ranges. Replies merge in order into one pair of typed arrays; any failed chunk (null reply, malformed length) voids the whole result so the caller falls back to the identical local fill rather than mixing partial buffers.

Parameters

action

string

WASM_ACTIONS message type the worker dispatches on.

base

Record<string, unknown>

Constant job payload shared by every chunk.

count

number

Total record count to fill across chunks.

fixedLen

boolean

When true every chunk must return exactly its range length (spiral/elliptical fills); false allows compacted results (belt/deep-field).

Returns

Promise<SFFill | null>

Merged fill buffers, or null on any failure → JS fallback.
